verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a built-in rules or automation engine where users define event-triggered actions. Webhooks (docs-17) only deliver event notifications to an external endpoint, which is a developer building block for constructing automation, not the capability itself. 'Replacing manual hiring tools with automation' is a vague marketing line with no rule-definition detail.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
